_readme: Template for a mobile-API adapter. Copy to data/captured/<platform>.json and fill in from a captured request — see docs/CAPTURE.md. data/ is gitignored because these files carry your auth token. Never commit one.
label: Flipkart Minutes

request._note: {{query}} is replaced with the search term. Put it wherever the app put the word you searched for — body field, path segment or query string.

map._note: Dot paths, with [0] for arrays: price.offers[0].amount. Omit itemsPath and the product array is detected automatically.
map.name: title
